####### Catch Data: Explore STATLANT 21A Database
https://www.nafo.int/Data/STATLANT-21A

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

stat <- read.csv("Ess_data/reviewed.STATLANT 21A 4VX.csv") ## Updated

# take a look 
head(stat)

# exclude 4X for now, as not on survey data
#stat <- subset(stat, Division != "4X")
# 4VW is the eastern Scotian Shelf. The NAFO divisions break down as:
# 
# 4V — eastern Scotian Shelf (northern part), sometimes subdivided into 4Vn and 4Vs (north and south of 44°N)
# 4W — eastern Scotian Shelf (western part)

stat <- subset(stat, Division %in% c("4VS", "4W"))

unique(stat$Species.Name)
names(stat)[1] <- "Year"
# Quick check to explore species in catch
stat_grouped_all <- stat %>%
  group_by(Year, Species.Name) %>%
  reframe(catch_g = sum(Metric.Tonnes) * 1e6) %>%
  filter(Year >= 1970) %>%
  filter(Year <= 1985) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Species.Name) %>%
  summarise(prop_catch = mean(catch_g))

stat_grouped_all$prop_catch <- stat_grouped_all$prop_catch / sum(stat_grouped_all$prop_catch) * 100
stat_grouped_all <- stat_grouped_all |> arrange(desc(prop_catch))

data <- transform(stat_grouped_all, Species.Name = reorder(Species.Name, 
            order(prop_catch, decreasing = TRUE)))

# Barplot
ggplot(data, aes(x = Species.Name, y = prop_catch)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_flip()

# top 10 species in prop_catch
data[1:50, ]

nafo_names <- c(
  "ATLANTIC COD - COD",
  "HADDOCK - HAD",
  "WHITE HAKE - HKW",
  "SILVER HAKE - HKS",
  "POLLOCK (SAITHE) - POK",
  "ATLANTIC REDFISHES (NS) - RED",
  "AMERICAN PLAICE - PLA",
  "YELLOWTAIL FLOUNDER - YEL",
  "ATLANTIC HERRING - HER",
  "CAPELIN - CAP",
  "ATLANTIC MACKEREL - MAC",
  "ARGENTINES (NS) - ARG",
  "SKATES (NS) - SKA",
  "SANDEELS (SANDLANCES) - SAN",
  "ATLANTIC HALIBUT - HAL"
)

# Return to original data to subset species in model
stat <- subset(stat, Species.Name %in% nafo_names)

# rename
stat$Species <- case_match(stat$Species.Name,
  "ATLANTIC COD - COD"            ~ "Atlantic Cod",
  "HADDOCK - HAD"                 ~ "Haddock",
  "WHITE HAKE - HKW"              ~ "White Hake",
  "SILVER HAKE - HKS"             ~ "Silver Hake",
  "POLLOCK (SAITHE) - POK"        ~ "Pollock",
  "ATLANTIC REDFISHES (NS) - RED" ~ "Redfish Unseparated",
  "AMERICAN PLAICE - PLA"         ~ "American Plaice",
  "YELLOWTAIL FLOUNDER - YEL"     ~ "Yellowtail Flounder",
  "ATLANTIC HERRING - HER"        ~ "Atlantic Herring",
  "CAPELIN - CAP"                 ~ "Capelin",
  "ATLANTIC MACKEREL - MAC"       ~ "Atlantic Mackerel",
  "ARGENTINES (NS) - ARG"         ~ "Atlantic Argentine",
  "SKATES (NS) - SKA" ~ "Skates Unseparated",
  "SANDEELS (SANDLANCES) - SAN"   ~ "Sand Lance",
  "ATLANTIC HALIBUT - HAL"        ~ "Atlantic Halibut",
  .default = stat$Species.Name
)
# checking if thorny skate is in the East (found absent)
# subset(stat, Species.Name == "THORNY SKATE (STARRY RAY) - RJR")

stat_grouped <- stat %>%
  group_by(Year, Species) %>%
  reframe(catch_g = sum(Metric.Tonnes) * 1e6)

# check plots
names(stat_grouped) <- c("Year", "Species", "Catches_g_per_yr")

ggplot(stat_grouped, aes(x = Year, y = Catches_g_per_yr, group = Species)) + 
  geom_line() + facet_wrap(~Species, scales = "free_y") 

ggplot(stat_grouped, aes(x = Year, y = Catches_g_per_yr, fill = Species)) + geom_area() 

saveRDS(stat_grouped, file = "Ess_data/NAFO_4VW_Catches.RDS")
#saveRDS(stat_grouped,"NAFO_4VW_Catches.RDS")
```



####### Effort Data: Explore STATLANT 21B Database
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)

# Standard column name vector
cols2 <- c("Year", "Country", "Gear", "Tonnage", "MainSpecies", "AreaCode",
           "SpeciesEffort", "Effort", "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun",
           "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec")

# Original column names for older files (60s-00s)
cols <- c("Year", "Country", "GearCode", "Tonnage", "MainSpecies", "Divcode",
          "Code", "Effort", "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun",
          "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec")

# Read and standardise older files
read_old <- function(path) {
  df <- read_delim(path)[, cols]
  names(df) <- cols2
  df
}

nafo60s  <- read_old("Ess_data/nafo-21b-60-69/NAFO21B-60-69.txt")
nafo70s  <- read_old("Ess_data/nafo-21b-70-79/NAFO21B-70-79.txt")
nafo80s  <- read_old("Ess_data/nafo-21b-80-89/NAFO21B-80-89.txt")
nafo90s  <- read_old("Ess_data/nafo-21b-90-99/NAFO21B-90-99.txt")
nafo00s  <- read_old("Ess_data/nafo-21b-2000-09/NAFO21B-2000-09.txt")

# Read newer files (already use cols2 names)
nafo10ss <- read_delim("Ess_data/NAFO-21B-2010-19/NAFO-21B-2010-2019.txt")[, cols2]
nafo20s  <- read_delim("Ess_data/NAFO-21B-2020-24/NAFO-21B-2020-24.txt")[, cols2]

# Combine all decades
nafo_21B <- rbind(nafo60s, nafo70s, nafo80s, nafo90s, nafo00s, nafo10ss, nafo20s)

# Coerce key columns to correct types
nafo_21B$SpeciesEffort <- as.numeric(nafo_21B$SpeciesEffort)
nafo_21B$Tonnage       <- as.numeric(nafo_21B$Tonnage)
nafo_21B$MainSpecies   <- as.character(nafo_21B$MainSpecies)

# Subset to valid species-effort codes and 4VW area codes
nafo_21B <- nafo_21B %>%
  subset(SpeciesEffort %in% c(1, 2, 3)) %>%
  subset(AreaCode %in% c(44, 45, 46, 48))

# Calculate total annual effort across months
nafo_21B$TotalEffort <- rowSums(nafo_21B[, c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun",
                                              "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec")])

# Keep only relevant columns
nafo_21B <- nafo_21B[, c("Year", "Country", "Gear", "Tonnage", "MainSpecies",
                          "AreaCode", "SpeciesEffort", "Effort", "TotalEffort")]

# Subset to days fished (SpeciesEffort == 2) and summarise
nafo_21B_grouped_daysfished <- nafo_21B %>%
  subset(SpeciesEffort == 2) %>%
  group_by(Year, Gear, Tonnage, MainSpecies, SpeciesEffort) %>%
  summarise(TotalDaysFished = sum(TotalEffort), .groups = "drop")

# Check available species codes
unique(nafo_21B_grouped_daysfished$MainSpecies)

# Subset to target species
# Note: 49 (Pelagic fish) used as Sand Lance placeholder (no NAFO code)
# Excluded: 53 (Sharks NS), 81 (Shortfin squid), 32 (Butterfish) - no NAFO codes
nafo_21B_subset <- filter(nafo_21B_grouped_daysfished,
  MainSpecies %in% c("1", "2", "21", "4", "6", "3", "10", "12",
                     "30", "52", "31", "51", "54", "49", "16"))
## removed thorny skate "54",
# Convert species codes to readable names
nafo_21B_subset$MainSpecies <- factor(
  nafo_21B_subset$MainSpecies,
  levels = c("1", "2", "21", "4", "6", "3", "10", "12",
             "30", "52", "31", "51", "54", "49", "16")
)
## removed thorny skate  "54"
levels(nafo_21B_subset$MainSpecies) <- c(
  "Atlantic Cod",        "Haddock",             "White Hake",
  "Silver Hake",         "Pollock",             "Redfish Unseparated",
  "American Plaice",     "Yellowtail Flounder", "Atlantic Herring",
  "Capelin",             "Atlantic Mackerel",   "Atlantic Argentine",
  "Skates Unseparated",   "Sand Lance",       "Atlantic Halibut"
)
## removed thorny skate  "Thorny Skate",

# Convert tonnage class to gross tonnage midpoint, then engine power (kW)
# Formula: Power (kW) = 11.26 x (Gross Tonnage ^ 0.71)  [Anticamara et al. 2011]
nafo_21B_subset <- nafo_21B_subset %>%
  mutate(
    GT = case_when(
      Tonnage %in% c(1, 2) ~ (0 + 49.9) / 2,
      Tonnage == 3         ~ (50 + 149.9) / 2,
      Tonnage == 4         ~ (150 + 499.9) / 2,
      Tonnage == 5         ~ (500 + 999.9) / 2,
      Tonnage == 6         ~ (1000 + 1999.9) / 2,
      Tonnage == 7         ~ (2000 + 5000) / 2,
      TRUE                 ~ NA_real_
    ),
    Power_kW          = 11.26 * GT ^ 0.71,
    Effort_kW_Days_yr = Power_kW * TotalDaysFished
  )

# Aggregate effort by year and species
nafo_21B_effort <- nafo_21B_subset %>%
  group_by(Year, MainSpecies) %>%
  summarise(Effort_kW_Days_yr = sum(Effort_kW_Days_yr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Plot effort by species over time
ggplot(nafo_21B_effort, aes(x = Year, y = Effort_kW_Days_yr,
group = MainSpecies, color = MainSpecies)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~MainSpecies, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```


## interp_effort
```{r}

library(zoo)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)  # needed for %>% and pivot_wider

# Create wide effort matrix
effort_ts <- nafo_21B_effort[, c("Year", "Effort_kW_Days_yr", "MainSpecies")] %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = MainSpecies, values_from = Effort_kW_Days_yr)

effort_matrix <- cbind(
  effort_ts[, "Year"],
  effort_ts[, "American Plaice"],      
  effort_ts[, "Atlantic Cod"],  
  effort_ts[, "Atlantic Herring"],    
  effort_ts[, "Atlantic Halibut"], 
  effort_ts[, "Redfish Unseparated"],   
  effort_ts[, "White Hake"],      
  effort_ts[, "Haddock"],  
  effort_ts[, "Sand Lance"],      
  effort_ts[, "Silver Hake"],        
  effort_ts[, "Pollock"],
  effort_ts[, "Atlantic Mackerel"], 
  effort_ts[, "Capelin"],      
  effort_ts[, "Skates Unseparated"], 
  effort_ts[, "Yellowtail Flounder"],
  effort_ts[, "Atlantic Argentine"]
)

# Remove Year column (stored as rownames)
effort_matrix <- as.data.frame(effort_matrix[, -1])  # Fix 1: broken hyperlink syntax
rownames(effort_matrix) <- unlist(effort_ts[, "Year"])
colnames(effort_matrix) <- c(
  "American Plaice",     "Atlantic Cod",        "Atlantic Herring",
  "Atlantic Halibut",    "Redfish Unseparated", "White Hake",
  "Haddock",             "Sand Lance",          "Silver Hake",
  "Pollock",             "Atlantic Mackerel",   "Capelin",
  "Skates Unseparated",    "Yellowtail Flounder", "Atlantic Argentine"  # Fix 2: column names now match cbind order
)

# Subset to 1960-2013
effort_matrix <- effort_matrix[as.character(1970:2022), ]

# Check for any completely empty columns before interpolating
empty_cols <- colSums(!is.na(effort_matrix)) == 0  # Fix 3: broken hyperlink syntax
if (any(empty_cols)) {
  warning("Columns with no data (all NA): ", 
          paste(colnames(effort_matrix)[empty_cols], collapse = ", "))
}

# Linear interpolation of gaps; boundary NAs held constant (rule = 2)
effort_interp <- apply(effort_matrix, 2, na.approx, 
                       na.rm = FALSE, maxgap = 30, rule = 2)

# Ensure rownames are preserved after apply (apply can drop them)
rownames(effort_interp) <- rownames(effort_matrix)  # Fix 4: apply() drops rownames

# Plot original (solid) vs interpolated (dashed)
par(mfrow = c(4, 4), mar = c(2, 2, 2, 1))
years <- as.numeric(rownames(effort_interp))

for (i in 1:15) {
  col_data <- effort_interp[, i]
  
  # Skip plot if all values are NA (e.g. Capelin)
  if (all(is.na(col_data))) {
    plot.new()
    title(main = paste(colnames(effort_interp)[i], "\n()"))
    next
  }
  
  plot(x    = years,
       y    = col_data,
       type = "l", col = "blue", lty = 2,
       main = colnames(effort_interp)[i], xlab = "", ylab = "Effort (kW Days/yr)")
  lines(x = years,
        y = effort_matrix[, i],
        col = "red", lty = 1)
}

saveRDS(effort_interp, file = "Ess_data/interp_effort_nafo.RDS")

```


## Catch Data Extration
```{r}
###### Catches
catches <- readRDS("Ess_data/NAFO_4VW_Catches.RDS")
catches_wide <- catches %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species, values_from = Catches_g_per_yr) %>%
  arrange(Year)

species_cols <- c(
  "American Plaice", "Atlantic Cod", "Atlantic Herring", "Atlantic Halibut",
  "Redfish Unseparated", "White Hake", "Haddock", "Sand Lance",
  "Silver Hake", "Pollock", "Atlantic Mackerel", "Capelin",
  "Skates Unseparated", "Yellowtail Flounder", "Atlantic Argentine"
)

# Add missing species as zero columns
missing_spp <- setdiff(species_cols, colnames(catches_wide))
catches_wide[, missing_spp] <- 0

catch_matrix <- as.matrix(catches_wide[, species_cols])
rownames(catch_matrix) <- as.character(catches_wide$Year)

###### Align effort and catch on shared years (>= 1970)
shared_years <- sort(intersect(rownames(catch_matrix), rownames(effort_interp)))
shared_years <- shared_years[shared_years >= "1970"]
cat("Shared year range:", min(shared_years), "-", max(shared_years), "\n")

catch_matrix  <- catch_matrix[shared_years, ]
effort_matrix <- effort_matrix[shared_years, ]
effort_interp <- effort_interp[shared_years, ]

###### Helper: safe normalisation
safe_norm <- function(x, mx) {
  if (is.na(mx) | mx == 0) rep(0, length(x)) else x / mx
}

# Harmonise column names
harmonise_colnames <- function(x) {
  gsub("^(.+) - [A-Z]+$", "\\1", colnames(x)) |>
    stringr::str_to_title()
}
colnames(catch_matrix)  <- harmonise_colnames(catch_matrix)
colnames(effort_matrix) <- harmonise_colnames(effort_matrix)

# Align skate name between catch and effort matrices
#colnames(catch_matrix)[colnames(catch_matrix) == "Skates Unseparated"] <- "Thorny Skate"

###### Plot: Relative Catches with Effort Interpolated
pdf("Ess_Output/new_RelativeCatcheswithEffortInterpolated.pdf")

shared_species  <- colnames(effort_interp)
n_species       <- length(shared_species)
panels_per_page <- 15
n_pages         <- ceiling(n_species / panels_per_page)

for (page in seq_len(n_pages)) {

  idx_start <- (page - 1) * panels_per_page + 1
  idx_end   <- min(page * panels_per_page, n_species)
  page_spp  <- shared_species[idx_start:idx_end]

  par(mfrow = c(4, 4), mar = c(2, 2, 2, 1))

  for (sp in page_spp) {

    e_interp <- effort_interp[, sp]
    e_raw    <- effort_matrix[, sp]

    # Guard: species may not exist in catch_matrix
    if (sp %in% colnames(catch_matrix)) {
      catch <- catch_matrix[, sp]
    } else {
      catch <- rep(NA_real_, length(e_interp))
    }

    x     <- as.numeric(rownames(effort_interp))
    e_max <- max(e_interp, na.rm = TRUE)
    c_max <- max(catch,    na.rm = TRUE)
    r_max <- max(e_raw,    na.rm = TRUE)

    plot(
      x, safe_norm(e_interp, e_max),
      type = "l", col = "green", lty = 2,
      ylim = c(0, 1),
      main = sp, xlab = "", ylab = "Relative Effort / Catch"
    )
    if (!all(is.na(catch))) lines(x, safe_norm(catch,  c_max), col = "red",  lty = 1)
    if (!all(is.na(e_raw)))  lines(x, safe_norm(e_raw,  r_max), col = "blue", lty = 1)
  }

  # Blank spacers then legend in final panel
  panels_used  <- length(page_spp)
  blank_panels <- panels_per_page - panels_used
  for (k in seq_len(blank_panels)) plot.new()

  plot.new()
  legend(
    "center",
    legend = c("Effort (interpolated)", "Effort (raw)", "Catch"),
    col    = c("green", "blue", "red"),
    lty    = c(2, 1, 1),
    lwd    = 2,
    bty    = "n",
    cex    = 1.2,
    title  = "Legend")
}

dev.off()
cat("PDF saved to Ess_Output/new_RelativeCatcheswithEffortInterpolated.pdf\n")

###### Relative effort scaling
relative_effort_interp <- apply(effort_interp, 2, function(x) {
  safe_norm(x, max(x, na.rm = TRUE))
})
relative_effort_interp <- as.matrix(relative_effort_interp)
rownames(relative_effort_interp) <- rownames(effort_interp)
colnames(relative_effort_interp) <- colnames(effort_interp)

## No reliable directed effort in NAFO 4VsW — set to zero
# relative_effort_interp[, "Sand Lance"]         <- 0.0
# relative_effort_interp[, "Capelin"]            <- 0.0
# relative_effort_interp[, "Atlantic Argentine"] <- 0.0
# relative_effort_interp[, "Skates Unseparated"]       <- 0.0


###### Save outputs
saveRDS(relative_effort_interp, file = "Ess_data/relative_interp_effort_nafo.RDS")
saveRDS(catch_matrix,           file = "Ess_data/catches_nafo.RDS")

catches_nafo <- readRDS("Ess_data/catches_nafo.RDS")
write.csv(catches_nafo, file = "Ess_data/catches_nafo.csv", row.names = TRUE)

```
